name: Inu
source:
The protagonist of this story.

Abandoned as a child by his father, he was given the name “dog” and raised by abusive parents. As a result, his personality is distorted. He was severely traumatised when he was a child, and since then he has been able to read people's emotions when he is sexually aroused. In order to take revenge on his father who abandoned him, he wandered around Japan, committing repeated assaults and crimes. He lives his life as a vagabond and develops bestial strength, vigour, and resilience. He is a cold-blooded nihilist and sadist who feels resentment about peaceful homes and women. He is a beautiful man in his own right.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070827142514/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/noise/noise_char.html]official site, archived[/url]]
